repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 過敏性鼻炎（鼻腔疾病主要類型）的症狀由組織胺 H1 受體介導，包括鼻癢、噴嚏、水樣分泌物。Cyproheptadine 的 H1 拮抗作用理論上可緩解上述症狀；抗膽鹼效應可能減少鼻腺體分泌。然而，第一代抗組織胺的嗜睡副作用限制其日常使用，現代指引已以第二代藥物取代。
急性喉咽炎主要由病毒（Rhinovirus, Coronavirus 等）或細菌（A 型鏈球菌）感染引起，炎症介質以細胞激素（IL-1β, TNF-α）為主，組織胺並非核心病理介質。Cyproheptadine 的抗組織胺和 5-HT2 拮抗機轉與感染性喉咽炎的病理生理聯繫極為薄弱，無合理的藥理學支持。
異位性皮膚炎的瘙癢部分由組織胺和 5-HT 介導，Cyproheptadine 的雙重拮抗在機轉上具潛在相關性。然而「難治性」異位性皮膚炎涉及複雜的 Th2/Th17 免疫失調（IL-4, IL-13, IL-31 軸），已有靶向生物製劑（Dupilumab, Tralokinumab）為標準治療，第一代抗組織胺的鎮靜效應可短暫緩解瘙癢但無疾病修飾作用。
Cyproheptadine 作用於 IgE 介導反應的下游（H1 受體層級），並非直接干預 IgE 產生、FcεRI 訊號或 Th2 分化等上游過敏致敏機轉。抗組織胺藥物不能降低 IgE 敏感性（atopy），機轉聯繫為間接且薄弱的推斷。
鼻咽炎（普通感冒）主要為病毒性感染，組織胺在其病理中的角色有限（急性期可能有少量肥大細胞反應）。現有 Cochrane 系統回顧顯示，抗組織胺藥物對普通感冒症狀的整體效益不顯著。機轉聯繫薄弱，且感冒使用第一代抗組織胺的嗜睡風險高於其效益。
玫瑰痤瘡相關結膜炎涉及神經血管功能失調、先天免疫激活（Toll-like receptor 信號），以及 cathelicidin（LL-37）的異常剪切。組織胺和血清素在此病理中的角色尚未建立，Cyproheptadine 的雙重拮抗機轉與此適應症的關聯性極弱，屬高度推測性。

Numerous such pharmacological agents have been identified but only few have found their way into clinical use. literature.abstract: This review focuses on the so-called "periodic syndromes of childhood that are precursors to migraine", as included in the Second Edition of the International Classification of Headache Disorders. Three periodic syndromes of childhood are included in the Second Edition of the International Classification of Headache Disorders: abdominal migraine, cyclic vomiting syndrome and benign paroxysmal vertigo, and a fourth, benign paroxysmal torticollis is presented in the Appendix. literature.title: Cyclic vomiting syndrome.
literature.abstract: Cyclic vomiting syndrome (CVS) is characterized by recurrent vomiting episodes. In this study, the mean ages at the onset of symptoms and at the diagnosis of children with cyclic vomiting pattern were 5.7 and 8.0 years, respectively. On average 2.3 years elapsed between the onset and diagnosis, suggesting the difficulty of diagnosing CVS. However, the prevalence of CVS ranges from approximately 0.3% to 2%. Its pathophysiology, prognosis, and natural history need to be further investigated. Vario

literature.title: Breastfeeding and migraine drugs.
literature.abstract: Breastfeeding women may suffer from migraine. While we have many drugs for its treatment and prophylaxis, the majority are poorly studied in breastfeeding women. We conducted a review of the most common anti-migraine drugs (AMDs) and we determined their lactation risk.

literature.title: Cyproheptadine Treatment in Children and Adolescents with Migraine: A Retrospective Study in Japan.
literature.abstract: Evidence on prophylactic drugs for pediatric migraine is limited, especially when comorbid conditions contribute to treatment resistance. This study evaluated the efficacy of cyproheptadine in children with migraine and explored the impact of comorbid neurodevelopmental disorders and orthostatic intolerance (OI).

literature.title: Cyclical Vomiting Syndrome in Individuals With BPTF Haploinsufficiency.
literature.abstract: Haploinsufficiency of the bromodomain PHD finger transcription factor (BPTF) gene, essential in chromatin remodeling, leads to a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by dysmorphic facies, distal limb anomalies, neurological disturbances, epilepsy, and gastrointestinal symptoms.

literature.title: Cyclic Vomiting Syndrome in Children.
literature.abstract: Cyclic vomiting syndrome (CVS) is a misrecognized and probably underdiagnosed episodic syndrome associated with migraine, occurring preferentially in childhood. Attacks are stereotyped for each individual, with predictable periodicity. This review summarizes recent clinical and paraclinical observations in this syndrome, and current approaches in explorations and therapeutics.

literature.title: Toward the definition of childhood migraine.
literature.abstract: The intent of this review is to provide an update on the current understanding of the diagnostic criteria, classification, pathophysiology, evaluation, and management of pediatric migraine.

literature.title: Histamine in migraine and brain.
literature.abstract: Histamine has been studied in both health and disease since the initial description a century ago. With its vasodilative effect, it was suggested early on to be involved in the pathophysiology of migraine. Over the past 25 years, much has been learned about histamine as a neurotransmitter in the central nervous system. The role of this neurotransmitter system in migraine has not been previously reviewed.

literature.abstract: The management of pediatric migraine requires a balance of biobehavioral measures coupled with agents for acute treatment and, if needed, daily preventive medicines. A recent American Academy of Neurology practice parameter has critically reviewed the limited data regarding the efficacy and safety of medicines for the acute and preventive therapy of pediatric migraine. literature.title: Pharmacologic treatment of childhood migraine.
literature.abstract: This review of pharmacologic treatment of childhood migraine shows that no agent for abortive treatment has been proved effective in controlled studies and that most commonly used prophylactic agents (e.g., propranolol and cyproheptadine) lack proof of their effectiveness. Flunarizine seems to be the only agent with positive results in controlled studies. This drug, although well tolerated, is slow to act. literature.title: Treatment of paediatric headache.
literature.abstract: Headaches are very common during childhood and become increasingly frequent during adolescence. The diagnosis of primary headache disorders (e.g., migraine and tension-type headache) rests principally on clinical criteria as set forth by the International Headache Society. Treatment options include acute or episodic measures, prophylactic agents and non-pharmacological or behavioural interventions. literature.title: Abdominal migraine: evidence for existence and treatment options.
literature.abstract: There is evidence to suggest that, in children, episodic abdominal pain occurring in the absence of headache may be a migrainous phenomenon. literature.title: Reconsideration of the diagnosis and treatment of childhood migraine: A practical review of clinical experiences.
literature.abstract: To provide insight into the wide spectrum of migraine during childhood to establish practical and comprehensive treatment strategies.

It might occur in conjunction with ipsilateral autonomic manifestations of trigeminal nerve stimulation. PH responds well to indomethacin treatment; however, considering the adverse effects of indomethacin, its long-term use is a matter of question and investigations about other prophylactic medications are going on, but they are inconclusive. literature.abstract: Episodic cluster headache is a well-recognized entity usually starting in the second decade of life. Uncommonly, the first typical symptoms may present in the first decade of life, but are rarely recognized as such during childhood. We report a 12-year-old girl who presented with a 1-year history of bouts of right-sided hemicrania with ipsilateral, clearly demarcated, redness and itching of the skin of the face, lasting from 15 minutes to 2 hours per day. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 三叉自律神經頭痛（TACs，包括陣發性偏側頭痛、叢集性頭痛）的病理涉及三叉-副交感神經反射弓激活及下視丘功能異常。5-HT2 拮抗作用可能調節三叉神經痛覺敏感化；組織胺作為神經傳導物質在叢集性頭痛中的角色已被確認（H1 受體位於三叉神經節），使 Cyproheptadine 的雙重機轉具合理的病理生理基礎。PMID:39434953（2024）提供了陣發性偏側頭痛的首個初步直接證據。
